name: @dhyeythumar/xd2llm
description: Bridges Adobe XD design tool with LLMs to provide design context, so LLMs can generate UI code more accurately based on the actual design tokens.

scripts.install: cd xd-context-extractor && npm ci && cd .. && cd xd-llm-connector && npm ci
scripts.setup: cd xd-context-extractor && npm run setup && cd .. && cd xd-llm-connector && npm run setup
